{{Quote|This is the captain of the freighter ''Suprosa''. Are you crazy? We're hauling fertilizer here! What kind of pirates are you?|[[Sivar]], to Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Shadows of the Empire (novel)">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>}}
'''Fertilizer''' was used to artificially introduce nutrients into soil to allow [[Farm/Legends|farming]]. It was used by the [[Pliith]] [[Species/Legends|species]].

The [[R0/5T.N1 tree feeder]] was capable of dispensing fertilizer through an [[adjustable sprayer nozzle]].<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> Fertilizer could be stored in [[Class-G cargo container|Class-G]] [[Cargo container/Legends|cargo containers]].<ref name="XWA">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''</ref>

[[Banthamax 4600-SL]] was a brand of fertilizer used on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:TMHP2">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|The Meatlumps Hideout, Part 2|Corellia}}</ref>
